summary.text: David Bennett is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 20 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bennett earned an A.A. in education and social work from Rhode Island Junior College and a B.A. in psychology from Rhode Island College.
His professional experience includes working as a psychiatric nurse, an orderly and a surgical assistant.

In the 2021-2022 legislative session Bennett chaired the House Environment and Natural Resources Committee and was also assigned to the Health, Education, and Welfare Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
